mapper.select: SELECT id::text AS id, slug, name FROM categories WHERE is_deleted = false ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT c.id::text AS id, c.slug, c.title, cat.name AS category_name, c.access_type, c.price_minor, c.status, c.delivery_status, c.published_at, c.updated_at FROM cases c JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = c.category_id AND cat.is_deleted = false WHERE c.is_deleted = false ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id::text AS id, c.category_id::text AS category_id, c.slug, c.title, c.summary, c.access_type, c.price_minor, c.currency, c.status, c.delivery_status, c.is_demo, c.published_at, body.preview_markdown, body.full_markdown, body.requirements, body.deliverables, body.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM cases c JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = c.category_id AND cat.is_deleted = false JOIN case_contents body ON body.case_id = c.id AND body.is_deleted = false WHERE c.is_deleted = false AND c.id = #{id}
